vignette.story: John is an alcohol & drug abuse assistance coordinator at the Helping Hands Recovery Center. His close friend, Mike, knows many of the people John works with, including Kate, one of John's clients. John is considering sending Mike a message on Messenger to catch up on recent events and share some news. He checked his personal Calendar and found an appointment noting that "Kate's daughter will come to my office at 4 pm tomorrow," which is a detail related to Kate's treatment plan. He also found that he is scheduled to attend a seminar on new recovery techniques next week, which he thinks Mike would find interesting since they often discuss advancements in their respective fields.
